Everyone gets noob gains at first, its once these initial gains stop, people get disheartened, or their need for instant gratification gets the best of them, and they quit the gym and move on to something else.

At some point you'll probably plateau, you'll find you can't get your bench or deadlift or whatever any higher. At that point, you can look into what you're eating. It may be you just need to eat more, or you may need to just add more protein to your current diet, really depends what you're eating. There are tons of guides out there, TDEE calculators, etc. that will say how many calories you should eat to meet your goals. I usually aim for about 1g of protein per lb of body weight, unless I'm on a cut.

The answer is basically that yeah, it's different for everyone. You'll hit a point where you can't quite get past 3x10 reps of whatever weight, and try again a day later, or two days later... and still can't do it, so you try again and... you get the point.
